items.title: Cosine expansion of the inverse spectrum

source.anchor: Fact C.7/A3.Ex133-137, full proof A3.SS3.2; standing kappa S4.SS1.p1.m4 and literal rho S4.Thmtheorem5; private C8 finite-grid use A3.SS3.p4.2.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling.
source.scope: Full scalar FactC7. Private deterministic grid exchange is a separately checked source-proof intermediate, not the Gaussian expectation or full C8 statement.

items.statement: The reciprocal cosine spectrum has an absolutely and uniformly convergent cosine expansion. \lambda(\theta)^{-1}=\frac1{\sqrt\kappa}\left(1+2\sum_{j\ge1}(-r)^j\cos(j\theta)\right). Fix \(\kappa\in\mathbb R\) with \(\kappa\ge2\), and set \(r=(\sqrt\kappa-1)/(\sqrt\kappa+1)\). The square root is the nonnegative real square root. For every real angle \(\theta\), define \(\lambda(\theta)=(\kappa+1)/2+(\kappa-1)\cos\theta/2\). The displayed equality is therefore exactly the source left side \(2/(\kappa+1+(\kappa-1)\cos\theta)\). The source series starts at \(j=1\). Lean uses \(j\in\mathbb N\) and mode \(j+1\) in both the power and cosine. Its partial sum indexed by \(N\) has exactly the first \(N\) positive modes. Absolute convergence is pointwise for each real angle. Uniform convergence is on all \(\mathbb R\) in the angle for this fixed \(\kappa\): one threshold works for every angle. No uniformity over unbounded \(\kappa\) is asserted. The bounds \(0<r<1\), nonzero denominators, summability and uniform convergence are proved internally. No dimension, Gaussian law, matrix input, radius certificate or convergence premise is supplied by the caller.

obligations.label: Exact normalized expansion for every real angle.
Absolute convergence at every real angle.
Uniform positive-mode partial sums on the full real angle domain at fixed kappa.

The consumer is an all-natural-n intermediate; source1<=n<d remains required later for C8 alias classification and closed moments. assumption_deltas.source: Standing real kappa>=2 and literal rho; every real theta.
assumption_deltas.lean: Exactly real kappa>=2; literal r in the statement; all-real-angle equality and convergence outputs. No dimension or matrix binder.
assumption_deltas.reason: C7 is scalar and dimension-free. Radius bounds and denominators are internally proved, not additional source hypotheses.

assumption_deltas.source: Positive-index series converges absolutely and uniformly in theta.
assumption_deltas.lean: Nat index j+1, Summable of the real term norm for every theta, and TendstoUniformly of the first N positive modes on all real theta, for each fixed kappa.
assumption_deltas.reason: Explicitly exposes the positive-mode index and the standard absolute/uniform senses; the uniform threshold does not depend on theta and is allowed to depend on kappa.
